_note: Hand-authored research trajectories, not recorded from live usage. The final question of each session is held out and must be recovered by the predictor.
_decoys: Each session lists plausible same-topic alternatives that did NOT come next. They join the candidate pool so that discrimination tests whether the predictor identified the specific question, not merely the topic. Without them the task collapses into six-way topic classification, which any on-topic guess wins.
